quote: Six clinical researchers ... independently annotated 20 videos ... Krippendorff's α score of 0.76 for all annotations across 310 videos, using detailed annotation guidelines.

With the sampled videos, we conducted multiple rounds of annotations with six clinical researchers as experts using our annotation scheme ( §B.1), resulting in a gold-standard dataset of 2,480 high-quality labels (8 myths×310 videos).
guideline: Annotators followed a two‑step annotation process with label definitions and were required to provide brief justification excerpts.

Experts assigned one of six labels: Opposes OUD Myths (-1), Neutral OUD Information (0), Supports OUD Myths (1), Irrelevant (2), URL Not Accessible (3), Non-English Language (4). For supporting or opposing videos, they specified the myth(s) involved, citing excerpts or timestamps. They reviewed metadata in priority order: title and description, then transcript. They provided a brief justification (∼10 words).
